clips.title: The story
paras: Alliance High Command fears the naga threat, and Stormwind Ho! gives Farren Orinelle a chance to leave Southshore. He hopes to take credit for their defeat and win a reassignment to Stormwind City.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle finds his Southshore posting miserable. The town sits on Lordaeron’s edge, hemmed in by Forsaken forces, syndicate brigands, and sea fiends. A city guardsman used to drunks and petty brawls in Stormwind, Farren longs to return south. His former mentor tells him Alliance High Command is increasingly anxious about naga encroaching on the coasts. Farren sees a chance to leave the north behind.

Farren admits he lacks the courage and skill to face Daggerspine sirens and shorehunters in open combat. He commissions you to scour the beaches southeast of Southshore and cull the naga ranks. He needs your martial feats to write an impressive dispatch to Major Samuelson in Stormwind, and hopes the credit will help him secure a reassignment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My former mentor in the Stormwind city guard sent a message to me that Alliance High Command is becoming concerned with the threat posed by the naga. From what he's heard, there's good chances for promotion--or at least reassignment--for anyone who proves valuable in this regard.

There's just one small problem... I can't handle the naga, friend. Oh sure, I could break up a drunken barroom brawl, or haul off a belligerent beggar, but the naga are too much for me. You've got to help me, friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I've a letter ready to go to Major Samuelson in Stormwind. All I need are the results.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With the naga put down in Southshore, I'll be a shoe-in to be reassigned. I'll get to see Stormwind again... Get away from this Light-forsaken port.
